symptom: A Data grid 2 column with no caption (empty or absent), no attribute and **no name** — `column (Caption: '', ShowContentAs: customContent) { actionbutton … }`, `column (Caption: '')`, bare `column { … }` — passes `mxcli check`, but `mx check --no-update-widgets` reports **CE0463** on the grid. `fix widgets` clears it; re-exec rewrites the page and CE0463 returns
cause: `applyColumnHeaderFallback` returned early when there was no fallback text (no attribute, no column name), leaving the header an empty texttemplate, which `overlayItemValue` serializes as `TextTemplate: null`. `mx update-widgets` writes an empty `Forms$ClientTemplate` there (Fallback Items[3], Parameters[2], Template Items[3])
insight: **The 2026-08-31 finding's "verified, 0 errors for custom-content columns (empty + absent caption)" was incomplete:** its tests and examples always passed a column NAME, so the name fallback hid the unnamed case. Fix: with no fallback, flag the header `EmptyTemplate` (in place, or appended) — scoped by the `hasHeaderSlot` gate, never all texttemplates (null vs empty differs per widget). Measured on 11.15.0 with update-widgets output as the reference: header shapes now byte-match it. A blind spot worth naming: a test fixture that always supplies the optional field (here the name) cannot see the branch where it is absent
